description: One stay by its confirmation number: guest, dates, room, status, rate plan, group, when it was booked, through what (the front desk, the booking page, Expedia…) and by whom (when recorded), and its security deposit and card holds — held, expired (past its valid-until date, still on the ledger until released), renewed, released or kept (holds are not charges and are never in the balance). Needs the owner's sign-in.
name: stay
title: One stay
